answers.reason: Full professors hold chairs and represent the highest academic rank, granting them seats in the central academic body.
University-wide budget allocation is a central administrative and leadership matter above the faculty chair level.
Selecting candidates for a vacant professorship is a core peer function of full professors.
As a chair holder in the faculty, the full professor is a senior member of the faculty council.
Full professors are responsible for teaching in the faculty and outrank the lower-level faculty committees.
As a senior office holder involved in teaching and supervision, the full professor may participate in faculty examination boards.
As a research group leader and chair holder, the full professor is eligible to take part in awarding internal faculty research grants.
The full professor teaches and holds a high faculty rank, permitting participation in lower-level working groups on teaching modules.
As a chair holder responsible for teaching and research, the full professor can participate in lower-level procurement for teaching laboratories.
Because those with a higher office may take part in bodies below their level, the full professor is permitted to join this lower-level faculty planning round.
